const b = box(40, 30, 10)
round(b.edge('top', 'right'), 12)
hole(b, { across: 35 })
hollow(b, { wall: 6, open: 'top' })

const b = box(40, 30, 10)
hole(b, { across: 0.1 })
hole(b, { across: 35 })
hole(b, { across: 4, at: [-12, 0] })
hole(b, { across: 4, at: [12, 0], countersink: { across: 8, angle: 175 } })

const b = box(40, 30, 10)
hole(b, { across: 4 })
hole(b, { across: 0.1, at: [15, 10] })
hole(b, { across: 4, along: 'x' })

const b = box(40, 30, 10)
hole(b, { across: 6, at: [-5, 0] })
round(b.edge('top', 'right'), 12)
hole(b, { across: 4, at: [0, 0] })
